headline: A renovated four-bedroom ranch, minutes from historic downtown Newnan.
description:
A move-in-ready ranch with everything on one level. New flooring and fresh paint run throughout, and the kitchen has new countertops and new appliances, including the oven, microwave and refrigerator. French doors open from the kitchen to the back deck.

The primary bedroom has a generous closet, and three more bedrooms work as guest rooms, a home office or extra living space. The house sits on a quiet residential street close to historic downtown Newnan, shopping, dining and Interstate 85.

The seller is offering up to $5,000 toward the buyer’s mortgage interest-rate buydown with an acceptable offer, subject to lender approval and applicable loan guidelines.

GAMLS #10856041.
features:
Single-level living
New flooring throughout
Fresh interior paint
New kitchen countertops
New oven, microwave and refrigerator
French doors to the back deck
Up to $5,000 toward a rate buydown (with an acceptable offer)
Near downtown Newnan, shopping and I-85
